question: ¿Cuál fue el total facturado por categoría de producto y país del cliente?
reference_sql: SELECT c.country, pc.category_name, SUM(ii.line_amount) AS total_invoiced FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ii.product_id JOIN product_categories pc ON pc.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.country, pc.category_name;

question: ¿Qué clientes tienen facturas vencidas y qué acciones de cobranza se les hicieron?
reference_sql: SELECT c.full_name, i.invoice_id, ca.action_type, ca.action_date FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN collection_actions ca ON ca.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue';

question: ¿Qué productos vendidos fueron despachados desde una bodega donde el inventario está por debajo del punto de reposición?
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, w.warehouse_name FROM shipment_items si JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = si.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = si.shipment_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id JOIN inventory inv ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND inv.product_id = p.product_id WHERE inv.quantity_on_hand < inv.reorder_point;

question: ¿Cuánto se pagó por las facturas de pedidos entregados en cada región de la bodega?
reference_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = w.region_id WHERE s.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.region_name;

question: ¿Qué monto de notas de crédito se emitió por segmento de cliente?
reference_sql: SELECT cs.segment_name, SUM(cn.amount) AS credit_note_amount FROM credit_notes cn JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = cn.invoice_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN customer_segments cs ON cs.segment_id = c.segment_id GROUP BY cs.segment_name;

question: ¿Cuántos pedidos confirmó cada representante para clientes con dirección de envío en Colombia?
reference_sql: SELECT sr.full_name, COUNT(*) AS confirmed_orders FROM orders o JOIN sales_representatives sr ON sr.sales_rep_id = o.sales_rep_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN customer_addresses ca ON ca.address_id = o.shipping_address_id AND ca.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'confirmed' AND ca.country = 'Colombia' GROUP BY sr.full_name;
